GD Topic: "AI vs Human Intelligence" This is a "compare & contrast" topic. Don't make it a fight. Show how they differ + how they work together. If you start first: 30-sec opener script > “Good morning friends, I’m [Your name]. To start, AI vs Human Intelligence is a key debate in 2026. Let’s define scope: AI means machine learning systems like Muse, ChatGPT that process data, while human intelligence is our creativity, emotion, and ethics. We can compare them on 3 fronts: speed, creativity, and decision-making. Starting with speed, AI clearly wins – it can scan 1 million medical papers in seconds, something no doctor can. But that raises the question of judgment. What do others think about where humans still lead?” Key points you can use – Boon/Bane style *Angle* | *AI Strength* | *Human Strength* | *GD Line* *Speed + Scale* | Analyzes terabytes in seconds. Ex: Google’s AlphaFold solved protein folding for 200M proteins | Slow, but deep focus. Can work on 1 problem for years | “AI handles quantity, humans handle quality” *Creativity* | Remixes existing data. Can generate 100 ad copies fast | True originality. Ex: Einstein’s theory came from thought, not data | “AI creates variations, humans create vision” *Emotion + Ethics* | No bias if data is clean, but no empathy. Can’t console a patient | Empathy, morality, gut feel. A nurse knows when data says ‘stable’ but patient looks off | “AI can diagnose, but only humans can heal” *Learning* | Needs huge data. Catastrophic forgetting problem | Learns from 1 example. A kid sees a dog once and remembers | “AI needs millions of cats, humans need one” *Jobs* | Replaces repetitive tasks. IMF 2024: 40% jobs exposed to AI | Creates new roles. AI trainer, prompt engineer didn’t exist in 2020 | “AI won’t replace humans, but humans using AI will replace humans not using AI” Smart stand to take in GD: “AI and human intelligence aren’t competitors – they’re collaborators. AI is like a calculator for the brain. It handles data, we handle decisions. The future is ‘Centaur model’: human + AI teams. For example, lawyers use AI to scan 10,000 case files, then apply human judgment for the final argument. So instead of AI vs Human, we should discuss AI with Human.” Entry lines if you join in the middle: 1. Build: “Adding to the point on speed, AI’s edge is real – but IBM’s 2023 study showed AI makes factual errors 15% of the time in law. That’s where human oversight becomes critical.” 2. Contrast: “I agree AI is fast, but we’re missing EQ. A manager firing someone via AI email caused backlash at XYZ Corp. Some decisions need human touch.” 3. Refocus: “We’ve debated who’s better. Can we also discuss sectors? AI for radiology, humans for psychiatry. It’s about fit, not fight.” Traps to avoid: 1. Sci-fi: “AI will take over the world” → Sounds filmy. Stick to 2026 reality. 2. Only technical: “Neural networks have transformers…” → No one cares. Use simple examples. 3. Picking extreme side: “Humans are useless now” → You’ll look immature. One-liner to end/summarize:   “So AI gives us answers, human intelligence gives us meaning. The winner isn’t one or the other – it’s the person who uses both.” Want me to give you 2-3 data points with sources you can quote in the GD?
